 Common Space, a nonprofit with plans to field a humanitarian satellite imagery constellation, announced that Satellogic will deliver its first spacecraft, a NewSat Mark V. Credit: Satellogic 
 WASHINGTON — Common Space, a non-profit building an Earth observation constellation for humanitarian use, is teaming up with Satellogic to launch its first satellite next summer.
